pk.context: 100 mg topical, steady state, healthy adults

tell: Only about 5% of each dose reaches the blood, with a 1.5 to 2.6 hour half-life, setting this vaginal cream apart.

clues.text: Only about 5% of a vaginal dose is absorbed systemically. There is little or no systemic accumulation after repeated dosing.
A water-soluble phosphate ester with a molecular weight of 504.96, inactive on its own until rapid hydrolysis in the body converts it to the active form.
Approved under an NDA as a 2% cream, one 5 gram applicatorful containing about 100 mg, given once a day.

No boxed warning. Contraindicated after hypersensitivity to any component or with a history of regional enteritis, ulcerative colitis or antibiotic-associated colitis; skin rashes are the most frequent reaction.
Bacterial vaginosis in non-pregnant women, and in pregnant women during the second and third trimester.
It inhibits bacterial protein synthesis by binding the 23S RNA of the 50S ribosomal subunit, and is predominantly bacteriostatic.
The generic name begins with C and has eleven letters.
